description: WaterfallBridge builds a waterfall/bridge chart from any measures you drag in as "pillars" — set each as an increase, decrease, or total, in any order. Expand any segment into a Top-N breakdown by a dimension, with automatic "Others" bucketing and native Power BI sorting support. Choose vertical or horizontal orientation, and add variance callouts comparing any two pillars, with independent decimal-place control for both the absolute value and the percentage. Includes tooltips, right-click context menu, high-contrast support, and full English/Portuguese localization.
